reset.last_report:
NOT VERIFIED ON THE FINAL CODE: taking the drawer out of the cabinet. It worked once on the arm (attempt 6, commit 37542bf, 0.1 cm error, layout check ok), but that run placed it at the old unsafe target and the pinch check, heights and lift limit have changed since. I did not re-create the done state, because inserting the drawer with about 1 mm clearance risks moving the cabinet. The first real episode will be the test.

WORKS ON THE HARDWARE (drawer standing on the table, pull up): attempt 12 (6fabb80) layout ok, but its own claim failed on a measurement bug, since fixed. Attempt 17 (f0c3117) 0.4 cm error, outline 9.8 cm from the edge, which led to the bias fix. Attempt 19 (07a16a8, final code) 0.36 cm error, outline 10.3 cm from the nearest edge, pull seen from above, claim success, layout check ok, 150 s.

NOT HANDLED: drawer lying on a side, upside down, or tilted so the pull cannot be seen. The program stops cleanly with a message and does not touch it.

WRITTEN BUT NEVER RUN ON THE ARM: carrying a drawer already in the gripper, escaping from a low start pose, lowering the drawer back after a lift force stop, and leaving a drawer that is already in place.

KNOWN RISK, ORCHESTRATOR CHECK: with the drawer motionless at [0.29, -0.02], the orchestrator's layout measurement found it only 14 of 20 times (attempt 15), because depth artifacts merge it with the cabinet or stretch its blob past the 16 cm size limit. Expect false reset failures until that check ignores the cabinet footprint or filters thin artifacts. I cannot change it from this workspace. The in-place path is meant to make a repeat cheap.

TABLE EDGE RULE: every release is refused if the drawer outline would be under 10 cm from an edge, using the operator's camera-side line. The side camera does not see that edge near the target, and the table end beyond the cabinet was not measured. To satisfy the rule the aim shifts inward by up to 1.8 cm of the 2 cm tolerance at the worst target, and the yaw is mostly near -30 deg, so yaw variation in the data will be small.

Reading debug frames from /tmp was denied, so helper scripts and frames are in notes/.
